// Fixture for app_check rule db-write-call (not compiled): a repository that
// only reads passes. The test places it at
// lib/features/diary/data/diary_repository.dart.
import 'package:drift/drift.dart';
import 'package:fb_mobile/core/changes/row_ops.dart';
import 'package:fb_mobile/core/db/app_database.dart';

final class DiaryRepository {
  DiaryRepository(this.db);

  final AppDatabase db;

  // Comments may say db.into(t).insert(row) or db.transaction(...).
  Stream<List<SettingRow>> watchAll() => db.select(db.settingsKv).watch();

  Future<int> count() async {
    final rows = await db
        .customSelect('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM settings_kv WHERE x = "update("')
        .get();
    return rows.single.read<int>('n');
  }

  // A handler plans writes as data; the applier runs them.
  RowOp plan(String id) => UpdateRow(
    db.settingsKv,
    id,
    const SettingsKvCompanion(valueJson: Value('1')),
  );

  bool isUpdated(String s) => s.endsWith('updated') || isInTransaction();
  bool isInTransaction() => false;
  void reupdate() => onUpdate();
  void onUpdate() {}
}
